item.title: OGE Dissertation and Thesis Workshop
item.description: Date: Wednesday, October 14, 2026 2:30 PM - 4:00 PM - Learn the basics of correct thesis organization and format, appropriate paper attribution and reference citation styles—plus a review of the most commonly found mistakes and ways to avoid them. This workshop is for any student who will be writing a MS thesis or PhD dissertation. Bring your questions! To register for this WebEx event:https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdFkgmVANxbN3fM_h4B_2HXGFobhyfkpRiw876g1tc6xFXRiA/viewform?usp=header

item.title: AI and Writing: Academic Integrity and Your Voice
item.description: Date: Wednesday, October 14, 2026 3:00 PM - 4:00 PM - In the age of AI, it is increasingly important to understand how AI can serve as an effective tool in the writing process, and what it means to use it with academic integrity. This workshop explores how to use AI effectively and responsibly while maintaining your own voice as a writer.

item.title: Math Colloquium: Marc Aurèle Gilles (Princeton University)
item.description: Date: Wednesday, October 14, 2026 11:00 AM - 12:00 PM - This Mathematical Sciences Colloquium will feature a presentation titled “Gaussian elimination revisited” by Marc Aurèle Gilles. He is an Assistant Professor of Mathematics at Princeton University. His research develops theory, algorithms, and software for scientific computing, with a focus on numerical linear algebra and statistical inference from noisy cryo-EM data.

item.title: A Lifted Lamp - Albany Pro Musica with RPI Concert Choir
item.description: The RPI Concert Choir is honored to join Albany Pro Musica on October 18, for A Lifted Lamp, a powerful concert celebrating the voices, stories, and enduring spirit of the American experience. Inspired by Emma Lazarus’s iconic poem The New Colossus, whose words welcome the world at the Statue of Liberty, the program explores themes of hope, belonging, resilience, and the promise of a better future through an inspiring collection of choral works. Starts at 3pm at Troy Savings Bank Music Hall.
